<a2ui>
// Initialize progress store for tracking reviewed cards
progress_store("flashcards-vocab")

// Track which cards have been reviewed
$/flashcards/reviewed = 0

// Define the flashcard data
$/flashcards/cards = [
  {front: "Ephemeral", back: "Lasting for a very short time; transitory"},
  {front: "Ubiquitous", back: "Present, appearing, or found everywhere"},
  {front: "Serendipity", back: "The occurrence of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way"},
  {front: "Pragmatic", back: "Dealing with things in a realistic, practical way based on actual circumstances"},
  {front: "Meticulous", back: "Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise"},
  {front: "Ambiguous", back: "Open to more than one interpretation; unclear in meaning"},
  {front: "Benevolent", back: "Kind, generous, and charitable; showing goodwill"},
  {front: "Diligent", back: "Having or showing care in one's work or duties"},
  {front: "Eloquent", back: "Fluent, persuasive, and expressive in speaking or writing"},
  {front: "Nostalgia", back: "A sentimental longing for the past, typically for a period or place with happy associations"}
]

root = color_section(
  accent="#4f46e5",
  style="tint",
  padding="40px",
  blocks=[
    heading("Vocabulary Flashcards"),
    body("Review these 10 vocabulary words. Click each card to flip and see the definition. Your progress is tracked as you review."),
    
    // Progress indicator
    course_progress_card(
      course_title="Vocabulary Review",
      modules=[
        {title: "Cards Reviewed", lessons_total: 10, lessons_done: $/flashcards/reviewed}
      ],
      accent="#4f46e5"
    ),
    
    spacer(height="24px"),
    
    // Flashcard deck
    flashcard_deck(
      cards=$/flashcards/cards,
      accent="#4f46e5",
      label_front="WORD",
      label_back="DEFINITION"
    ),
    
    spacer(height="24px"),
    body("**Tip:** Review each card to strengthen your vocabulary knowledge. Return anytime to continue practicing.")
  ]
)
</a2ui>
